tldr: Venus in Capricorn: love is serious, loyal, and built through time.
body: With Venus in Capricorn, affection may be reserved at first, but it values commitment, reliability, and shared ambition. Love becomes real through consistency.
gift: Loyalty, maturity, practical devotion, and the ability to build lasting value.
challenge: Guardedness, transactional relating, and confusing emotional safety with control.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
